note: The rig for the handle-finish masters — system renders under the finish rule (materials-feed addendum 1): one handle form, one light, one crop and angle, so the fifteen read as a family. scripts/render-finishes.mjs reads this file and data/range.json's finish names and notes, calls the provider named, refuses any image under the rule's floor, writes the master into the store and a row into data/finish-masters.json. Every master is a SYSTEM render and carries the caveat below wherever it shows: on the tile, in the feed, in the pack. Nothing here names a decor; the finish names and their notes are data/range.json's.
caveat: Illustration only — a system render of the finish, not the maker's photograph. Colour and lustre are approximate; a sample is shown at the visit.

rights.licence: Sturij — illustration only; not the maker's imagery

gemini.note: the 2K size is the pro image model's; the flash image model answers 1024 px and fails the floor — the script says so rather than upscaling

prompt.template: Product photograph, macro, of a single slim D-shaped cabinet pull handle in {finish}. {finish_note} The handle is mounted horizontally, centred, on a flat matt charcoal slab door that fills the frame; three-quarter view from slightly above and to the right; soft north daylight from the left through a large softbox, a gentle fall-off to the right, one soft contact shadow; shallow depth of field on the handle's near end; the metal's true colour, machining marks, grain and lustre rendered faithfully. Square frame, photographic realism, no text, no watermark, no logo, no other object, no hand, no reflection of a camera or a person.
prompt.negatives: Not a rendering that looks painted or plastic; not gold-plated when the finish is brass; not mirror-chrome unless the finish says polished; no visible screws unless the finish note asks; no second handle; no wood-grain door.

family.crop: square, the handle across the middle third
